scope: Independent read-only review of the new public multi-market terminal; prior MA5 lab review is separate. No external network requests were made by this reviewer.

decision.scope: Read-only public market-data terminal, with explicit coverage and source limitations.

findings.problem: Contradictory open/close outside high-low range were retained as valid OHLC.
findings.initial_reproduction: Synthetic high=105/low=99 accepted open=100/close=50, open=-1/close=101, and open=100/close=106; each returned ok=true, retained=1, dropped=0.
findings.fix: General low <= min(open,close) <= max(open,close) <= high validation.
findings.verification: The same three synthetic examples now return zero rows, dropped_rows=1 and partial=true.

findings.problem: HTTP/CLI caller could request BTC-USD as us_equity and receive a crypto candle labelled US securities and share volume; missing identity metadata was accepted.
findings.initial_reproduction: Synthetic Yahoo meta with symbol BTC-USD, CRYPTOCURRENCY, exchange CCC produced ok=true under us_equity.
findings.fix: Required symbol, type, exchange, timezone and currency; conservative observed US venue/type checks; A-share code family/suffix checks and matching SHH/SHZ metadata. B-share and unrelated symbols rejected; unsupported venues remain explicit failures.
findings.verification: Original synthetic crypto reproduction rejected; AAPL/900901.SS rejected under cn_equity before fetch; expanded missing/wrong-metadata unit tests pass.

findings.problem: OKX shared candle endpoint allowed BTC-USDT-SWAP to be labelled dated futures.
findings.initial_reproduction: Synthetic successful OKX response passed with market=okx_futures and symbol=BTC-USDT-SWAP.
findings.fix: Canonical SWAP versus dated-contract suffix validation before GET.
findings.verification: Both wrong-subtype directions now reject with no network call; correct dated-contract fixture passes.

findings.problem: curl read default curlrc, which could add credentials, redirects, retry or method overrides despite the transport contract.
findings.evidence: Local curl --manual confirms default curlrc loading and requirement that --disable be the first option.
findings.fix: --disable is curl first option, including the conditional Referer branch.
findings.verification: Independent mocked process assertions cover ordinary and Referer endpoints, --max-time 12, communicate(timeout=12), and no redirect/retry/user options.

tests.command: uv run --extra research pytest -q tests/test_market_providers.py tests/test_market_server.py tests/test_market_transport.py

tests.result: PASS: eight catalogs, search, manual fetching, 100000/15m request, old-market response races, null taker, failure clearing, tiny nonzero prices/axes, 320px layout, no JS errors
PASS: original counterexamples rejected; curl configuration isolated; real localhost client disconnect prevents another synthetic upstream page

positive_controls: Source/market identities and derivative volume units remain distinct; Gate is explicitly USDT perpetual, not cash equities or spot.
Only 1m/5m/15m accepted; Binance/Gate pages <=1000 and OKX pages <=300; Yahoo historical request windows bounded to <=1000 interval slots.
Missing/nonfinite fields are not zero-filled; incomplete candles carry closed status and source/time basis.
HTTP/application/non-JSON errors are explicit; no source substitution or invented candles.
12-second individual GET deadline is enforced by curl and process timeout/kill; a multi-page operation can take longer and UI cancellation is separately disclosed.
Host/Origin restrictions, fixed server routes, approved HTTPS endpoints and query allowlists limit local API exposure; no orders, credentials or arbitrary-file routes.
UI only initiates candles on user action, checks response identity, discards stale response races, clears old price displays and avoids presenting tiny nonzero numbers as zero.
remaining_limits: US Yahoo quote identity currently allows only observed NMS/NGM/NYQ EQUITY/ETF, New York timezone and USD; broader catalog entries can explicitly fail as unsupported.
A-share directory contains historical/delisted/alias entries, not a certified active trading universe. BJ quote identity remains unsupported.
Normal-session filtering is not certification of each holiday/half-day exchange calendar; stale/latest-trading-day prices are not promised realtime.
Actual provider outages/rate restrictions and upstream economic correctness are not independently certified.
No backtests, strategy signals, alpha, order execution or trading readiness were validated by this review.
